intro.fr: Crash Team Racing se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Crash Team Racing can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Naughty Dog sort Crash Team Racing en 1999.
text.en: Naughty Dog releases Crash Team Racing in 1999.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub dowlle/ctr-native-ap, qui héberge l'APWorld de Crash Team Racing.
text.en: The GitHub repository dowlle/ctr-native-ap, home of the Crash Team Racing APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.1.0.
text.en: The first version, v0.1.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.2.4, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (18 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.2.4 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (18 versions released).

text.fr: Crash Team Racing figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Crash Team Racing is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
